description: This PHP class 'EmergencyContact' within the OrangeHRM system represents a Data Transfer Object (DTO) that encapsulates emergency contact information for an employee. It extends a base DTO class, normalizes emergency contact data into an array based on specified fields, and interacts with the Employee entity to retrieve emergency contact details.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates emergency contact information for an employee, providing methods to convert data to an array and define field mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DTO with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array of emergency contact details based on the specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Defines the mapping between field identifiers and Employee entity getter methods.
